name: Cluster
description: Children side by side, wrapping onto new rows when they run out of width, a step of the spacing scale apart both ways (a wrapping flex row with a gap).
usage: Tags, filters, buttons, metadata: a row that may wrap
`gap` takes the spacing scale's names (default sm, 16px)
`align` places items across the row (default center; baseline for text of mixed sizes); `justify` along it (between pushes the ends apart)
design: The same gap between items in a row and between rows

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, across and between rows

props.name: as
props.description: The element; ul/ol for a list, whose children are then your li

props.name: className
props.description: On the element. Set the gap with `gap`, not a gap-* class: cn doesn't merge the named spacing classes, so both would apply

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Any other attribute (aria-label, data-*, id) goes on the element
